name: In App
description: A transaction initiated inside a native or installed application

name: In Person
description: A transaction initiated with the customer at a staffed or unattended physical location

name: Mail Order
description: A remote transaction initiated through postal correspondence

name: Online
description: A transaction initiated through a web or other online checkout outside a native application

name: Other Remote
description: A known remote interaction surface outside the named normalized values

name: Telephone Order
description: A remote transaction initiated through a voice telephone interaction

name: Unknown
description: The transaction channel was not supplied or could not be determined
